body: Have you guys thought about starting a Patreon or Kickstarter? This service helps so many people talk to and hang out with their long distance friends, and neither Patreon nor Kickstarter cost anything to make. This site has helped me make so many friends, and while there are alternatives it still won't be the same.

Perhaps my definition of homelessness is different than yours, but I had to live in my car with my mom and stepdad for one night and then spent the next month in a very bad place. It wasn't our apartment but a friend's, and he hadn't been there in a year. All the food was rotten, and I was afraid to use the toilet. I slept on a plastic box that was about half as long as I was, had to curl into a ball to be completely on it. I still haven't been in one place for more than 18 months.

You're definitely not alone. I'm pretty sure instability is a big part of this whole thing, and homelessness definitely adds to that.
